content:
**Excited to Share Some Big News!** 🎉

I’m thrilled to announce that I’ve officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**! Since 2017, I’ve been deeply involved with the CDS Hooks standard, and I’m honored to now take on a leadership role to help shape its future.

CDS Hooks is a powerful way to integrate clinical decision support directly into workflows, and I’m excited to collaborate with the community to advance the standard further.

**Already using CDS Hooks?** Please add your implementation to the [CDS Hooks Availability Wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability) to help others discover and learn from your work!

**Not using CDS Hooks yet?** If you’re looking to implement the standard, I’m available as a **freelance consultant** to guide you through the process. Let’s build smarter, more connected healthcare solutions together!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #HealthcareInnovation #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #FreelanceConsultant

Would love to hear your thoughts and experiences with CDS Hooks—let’s connect! 🚀
